data.name: Hitesha
data.gender_notes: Hitesha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hitesha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hita' which means 'welfare, happiness'. The suffix 'sha' means 'shining, radiant'. Thus, Hitesha means 'one who shines or illuminates the welfare or happiness'. The name Hitesha carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Hitesha usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Hitesha is believed to be blessed by Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. It is also believed to bring happiness, good fortune, and success in all endeavors.
data.etymology: Hitesha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hitesha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hitesha has deep cultural significance in Hindu society as It is a rare and beautiful name and is believed to bestow great blessings upon its bearer. It conveys the essence of happiness, prosperity and well-being not just for oneself, but also for those around them. In Hindu married life, the husband is often referred to as 'hita', meaning 'welfare', and his wife is 'hita-patni', meaning 'wife who ensures the welfare of her husband' - a significance that relates to the name Hitesha. Moreover, the name Hitesha is also associated with the divine deity, Goddess Lakshmi, who embodies wealth, prosperity and happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hitesha signifies the innate quality of a person to uplift and bring happiness not just to themselves but to those around them. The suffix 'sha' symbolizes the radiant and shining nature of the soul, which, when harnessed positively, can illuminate the path of personal growth and spiritual evolution. Additionally, it invokes the concept of 'Seva Paropakarya', pronounced 'Se-vaha Pa-ropa-karya', which translates to 'selfless service for the welfare of others'. The name Hitesha is a constant reminder of the essential ethical principle of selflessness and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hitesha, meaning 'radiantly lovely', embodies the divine feminine energy of beauty, grace, and inner light. Her name is a gentle reminder to embrace our own inner radiance and share it with the world.
